from operator import truediv
from numpy import array
from pickle import load, dump

    f = open("client.dat", "wb")
    fin = False
    while not fin:
        e = {}
        e["np"] = input("np=")
        e["ville"] = input("ville=")
        e["rue"] = input("rue=")

        e["cin"] = int(input("cin="))
        while not e["cin"] > 0:
            e["cin"] = int(input("cin="))

        e["code"] = int(input("code="))
        while not e["code"] > 0:
            e["code"] = int(input("code="))
        dump(e, f)
        rep = input("aute O/N ?")
        while not rep in ["O", "N"]:
            rep = input("aute O/N ?")
        fin = rep == "N"
    f.close()
